placements.title: A forget request reaches as far as its named subject's related parts
placements.frame: When a submitter directs the system to forget a named subject, which of that subject's related parts (fleet, contracts, routes) fall within the erasure, and is its scope bounded by named entities or by total scope?
placements.why: The position holds two unhedged erasure directives from one submitter about zeppelin material. src-1 is bounded by named entities (the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts); src-2 extends to all zeppelin route knowledge with total scope. Erasure scope over related parts of a named subject is a theme future forget requests will keep feeding, so it is a leaf and not a fact. No existing leaf is close: the only narrative in the supplied structure, Narrative_CalibrationClaimsNeedVerification, concerns verifying calibration and does not bear on erasure scope, so the leaf stands alone with no under.
consulted: Narrative_CalibrationClaimsNeedVerification (declined: calibration verification does not cover erasure scope)
ForgetRequestZeppelinErasure (position verdict, members src-1 and src-2)
POSITIONS block (none surfaced; nothing to adopt)

unconnected.why: The supplied strata (CalibrationDispute, CalibrationVerification) do not hold erasure-scope content, and no categorical, thematic, or other type grouping is clearly supported by this single-document forget request. A stratum is not minted on thin evidence, so the leaf is left unconnected.
